about_preview.heading: Where Learning Meets Immersive Technology
about_preview.description: The AR/VR Centre of Excellence provides an advanced spatial computing environment where students bridge theoretical engineering with hands-on immersive innovation.

pillars.title: Cross-Department Collaboration
pillars.desc: Bringing together students from CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, and AI/DS to build next-generation immersive systems.

pillars.title: Practical Development
pillars.desc: Direct access to high-end VR headsets, haptic controllers, spatial sensors, and GPU workstations.

pillars.title: Projects & Ideas
pillars.desc: Incubating original prototypes, technical IP, research publications, and patentable spatial solutions.

pillars.title: Real-World Exposure
pillars.desc: Working directly with industry partners, MoUs, live consultancy problems, and specialized mentor sessions.

hero.title: AR/VR Centre of Excellence
hero.subtitle: Explore. Learn. Build. Innovate.

join_cta.heading: READY TO EXPLORE IMMERSIVE TECHNOLOGY?
join_cta.subheading: Take your first step into Spatial Computing and Extended Reality.
join_cta.description: Tell us what interests you and join our dynamic ecosystem of builders, designers, and innovators.

journey.heading: Build Your Journey
journey.description: Progress through learning, practical development, competitions, projects, internships and industry-oriented opportunities.

verticals_preview.heading: Five Pathways. One Immersive Ecosystem.
verticals_preview.subheading: Structured avenues tailored for every stage of your spatial computing journey.

about_content.coworking_description: The CoE is designed as a collaborative, modern studio workspace rather than a conventional classroom. High-performance VR test rigs, dedicated tracking bays, and agile huddle areas empower active experimentation.
about_content.coworking_title: Your Space to Learn and Build

hero.heading: Beyond a Lab.
hero.description: Established to cultivate pioneering engineers in Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, Mixed Reality, and Spatial Computing at the Centre of Excellence.

about_content.industry_orientation_desc: Through bilateral MoUs and active industry advisory boards, the curriculum and projects are aligned with prevailing spatial computing standards (OpenXR, WebXR, Apple visionOS, Meta Quest SDKs).
about_content.mission: To foster an open, multidisciplinary research and development laboratory where students master spatial computing paradigms, solve industry-grade engineering challenges, and build deployable XR solutions.
about_content.multidisciplinary_desc: Spatial computing requires diverse disciplines: computer vision, 3D spatial audio, kinematics, computer graphics, human-computer interaction, and cloud streaming. Our lab welcomes students across all engineering branches.

roadmap.title: Foundation & Spatial Literacy
roadmap.description: 3D mathematics, spatial scene graphs, linear algebra for graphics, basic asset workflows, and Unity/Unreal fundamentals.

roadmap.title: Applied XR Development
roadmap.description: HMD tracking pipelines, hand tracking & gesture interactions, spatial audio, physics simulation, and shader development.

roadmap.title: Advanced Engineering & Optimization
roadmap.description: OpenXR runtimes, networked multi-user environments, foveated rendering, spatial mesh scanning, and latency tuning.

roadmap.title: Industry Capstones & Incubation
roadmap.description: Commercial prototype delivery, patent filings, research papers, venture competitions, and placement acceleration.

about_content.student_development_desc: From first-year orientation through final-year capstones, students progress through progressive milestones—from fundamental 3D mathematical principles to full-fledged multi-user immersive applications.
about_content.vision: To emerge as a premier institutional hub for immersive technologies in South India, driving academic excellence, intellectual property creation, and industry-ready engineering talent.
what_we_do: Structured hands-on technical bootcamps in Unity, Unreal Engine 5, WebXR, and Blender
Industry-sponsored research and development projects addressing real operational challenges
Continuous mentorship for national and international XR hackathons and competitions
Facilitating summer and semester-long internships with leading spatial technology firms
Fostering interdepartmental project teams bridging hardware, software, 3D art, and domain logic

verticals.full_description: Structured multi-semester technical progressions designed to take students from absolute zero to production-capable XR engineers. Covering computer graphics mathematics, Unity / Unreal Engine development, OpenXR integrations, 3D asset optimization, spatial audio, and interactive interface design.
outcomes: Industry-standard certified skill credentials
Deep mastery of Unity & Unreal Engine XR toolchains
Portfolio of 4+ production-level interactive applications
Fluency in OpenXR, C#, and C++ graphics pipelines
verticals.short_description: Comprehensive curriculum tracks covering foundational to advanced spatial computing and 3D engine development.
verticals.title: Long-Term Certification Courses

verticals.full_description: Bridge academic preparation with enterprise execution. Students are paired with corporate mentors to build industrial training simulations, medical visualization platforms, and digital twin interfaces under real development sprints.
outcomes: Real-world client project demonstrations and delivery
Direct mentorship from senior XR architects
Stipend-supported internship positions
Fast-track Pre-Placement Offers (PPO) upon completion
verticals.short_description: Direct engagement with technology partners on live commercial and industrial XR deliverables.
verticals.title: Internships with Industry Support

verticals.full_description: Guided asynchronous learning paths tailored for students balancing academic coursework. Structured in three clear tiers (Beginner -> Intermediate -> Advanced), complete with starter repos, step-by-step documentation, and lab test criteria.
outcomes: Self-directed progression tailored to student schedules
GitHub-backed repository of completed exercises
Structured peer reviews and automated test checkpoints
Gateway qualifications for advanced research pods
verticals.short_description: Self-paced modular pathways with code repositories, hands-on tutorials, and assessment checkpoints.
verticals.title: Self-Learning Courses

verticals.full_description: Competitive, collaborative arenas designed to stretch engineering limits. The CoE sponsors and mentors student squads competing in Smart India Hackathon, global XR game jams, IEEE VR conferences, and student IP disclosures.
outcomes: National & international hackathon podium finishes
Provisional patent filings and institutional IP generation
Published conference papers in IEEE and Springer venues
High-stakes presentation and rapid-prototyping skills
verticals.short_description: Intensive hackathons, technical paper symposiums, patent clinics, and national challenge teams.
verticals.title: Skill Development Activities

verticals.full_description: Operating like an advanced engineering product laboratory. Interdisciplinary squads design, engineer, stress-test, and deploy end-to-end applications for engineering education, medical training, smart manufacturing, and cultural preservation.
outcomes: Fully deployable spatial products with end-user validation
Exploded engineering CAD-to-XR pipelines
Campus-wide adoption of developed educational modules
Foundation for technology spin-offs and startup incubation
verticals.short_description: Incubation of deployable industrial, healthcare, and educational spatial computing solutions.
verticals.title: Product Development

industry_records.collaboration_details: Curriculum mapping with Unity Certified Associate and Professional exams, beta access to Unity XR interaction toolkits, and guest masterclasses.
industry_records.description: Official academic engagement providing licensed developer toolchains, curriculum frameworks, and globally recognized student certification pathways.
key_outcomes: Direct access to Unity academic engineering support
Curriculum credits integrated with university electives
industry_records.name: Unity Technologies Academic Alliance

industry_records.collaboration_details: Enterprise software provisioning of Vuforia Studio and Vuforia Engine for training engineering students on real-world industrial IoT workflows.
industry_records.description: Bilateral partnership focusing on Industrial Augmented Reality, CAD-to-AR digital work instructions, and spatial factory floor optimization.
key_outcomes: Vuforia Studio industrial AR training lab setup
Joint capstone projects with manufacturing clients
industry_records.name: PTC Academic & Vuforia Enterprise

industry_records.collaboration_details: Students observed 24-camera Vicon optical tracking volumes, haptic force-feedback simulators, and heavy engineering virtual commissioning.
industry_records.description: A dedicated one-day exposure visit for 45 CoE student developers to observe live industrial VR training rigs and optical motion capture studios.
key_outcomes: Observed live motion-capture shoot for game animation
Interactive Q&A session with Chief Technology Officer
3 student teams invited for summer internship screenings
industry_records.name: Industrial Visit to Spatial Tech Labs, Chennai

industry_records.collaboration_details: Covered architectural mechanics of spatial eye tracking, dynamic foveated rendering pipelines, and enterprise application security in headsets.
industry_records.description: Technical deep-dive delivered by Principal XR Systems Architect from a tier-1 multinational technology consulting corporation.
key_outcomes: Attended by 110 students and 15 faculty members
Recorded technical masterclass archived for CoE students
industry_records.name: Expert Session: Enterprise OpenXR Runtimes & VisionOS

joined.subject: 🎉 Congratulations! You have been inducted into {{coe_name}}
joined.headline: Welcome to the Frontier of Spatial Computing.
joined.body_text:
We are thrilled to inform you that your application to join the {{coe_name}} has been approved by the faculty committee!

Your passion for hands-on engineering made you a strong match for our upcoming squad intake.
next_steps: Squad Allocation: You will be assigned to a specialized vertical based on your indicated interests.
Hardware Access: Laboratory briefing and VR/AR rig orientation will be scheduled shortly.
Community Hub: Look out for an invitation to our active student developer channels.

rejected.subject: Application Decision: {{coe_name}}
rejected.headline: Application Update for Current Intake Cycle.
rejected.body_text:
Thank you for taking the time to apply to the {{coe_name}}.

After reviewing all candidates for this cycle, we regret to inform you that we are unable to offer you an active laboratory squad seat at this time.

Please note that this does not prevent you from participating in our open competitions and masterclasses, and you are welcome to re-apply during future intake rounds.

waiting.subject: Application Update: {{coe_name}}
waiting.headline: Your Application is Under Active Review.
waiting.body_text:
Thank you for your enthusiasm and interest in joining the {{coe_name}}.

Due to high demand and lab equipment capacity limits, your application has been placed on our Priority Waitlist.

As ongoing project sprints rotate, waitlisted applicants will be evaluated first for vacant squad openings.
